char-player.name: The Traveler
char-player.description: A mysterious traveler who has lost their memory. They awoke in a strange tavern with no recollection of who they are or how they got here.
char-player.short_description: An amnesiac traveler seeking their identity

char-innkeeper.name: Maren
char-innkeeper.description: The innkeeper of The Crossroads — a stout, warm-hearted woman with silver-streaked hair and knowing eyes. She's seen many travelers pass through, but something about this one is different.
char-innkeeper.short_description: Warm-hearted innkeeper who found the traveler

properties.appearance: Silver-streaked auburn hair, weathered hands, always wearing a blue apron

loc-tavern.name: The Crossroads Inn
loc-tavern.description: A weathered tavern at the junction of three roads. Warm light spills from its windows. Inside: crackling fireplace, oak beams, the smell of stew and pine. A place where stories begin.
loc-tavern.short_description: A welcoming tavern at a crossroads

loc-forest.name: The Whispering Woods
loc-forest.description: A dark forest that surrounds the crossroads. The trees seem to lean in and listen. Locals say the woods are alive — and they remember.

plot-awakening.name: The Awakening
plot-awakening.description: The traveler must discover who they are and why they were found unconscious on the crossroads with a strange symbol burned into their palm.
plot-awakening.short_description: Discover your identity and the meaning of the mark

item-amulet.name: Strange Amulet
item-amulet.description: A small amulet found in the traveler's pocket. It pulses with faint warmth and bears the same symbol as the mark on their palm. It seems to react to magic.
item-amulet.short_description: A pulsing amulet matching the traveler's mark
